z-m-16-01.title: I mutsara unopa prime number chero nhamba yauri kuisa mu n here?
z-m-16-01.topic: Prime numbers ne composite numbers, mitengo yemitsara ine mavara
z-m-16-01.goal: Dzidza kuti kuva nechokwadi kakawanda hakuvimbisi 'nguva dzose,' gadzirisa kuti une chokwadi zvakadini kuti zvienderane nedata, uye utsvage counterexample iwe pachako.
z-m-16-01.material: Shamwari yeboka rema math yakati, "Kana n i integer i 0 kana kupfuura, sa 0, 1, 2, ..., mutengo we n×n+n+41 (n kuwanza n pamwe n pamwe 41) unogara i prime number!" Prime number i nhamba i 2 kana kupfuura ine divisors dzayo chete i 1 nayo pachayo, uye nhamba i 2 kana kupfuura isiri prime i composite number.
z-m-16-01.thinking.0: Kusiyanisa nhamba yezviitiko zvakatarisirwa ne 'zviitiko zvese'
z-m-16-01.thinking.1: Kugadzirisa kuti une chokwadi zvakadini zvichienderana nedata itsva
z-m-16-01.prereq.0: Zvinoreva prime ne composite numbers (prime i nhamba i 2 kana kupfuura ine divisors dzayo chete i 1 nayo pachayo)
z-m-16-01.prereq.1: Kuisa nhamba panzvimbo yeravara n kuwana mutengo wemutsara (n×n i n squared)
z-m-16-01.prereq.2: Kuverenga nekupatsanura nhamba dzine madhijiti kusvika mana nenhamba diki zvakatevedzana
z-m-16-01.s.s1.prompt: Data inoratidzwa chidimbu chimwe panguva. Nguva imwe neimwe data itsva yabuda, sarudza chakanyanya kuswedera pane zvaunofunga zvino.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.hint.0: Pachidimbu chimwe nechimwe chedata, patsanura 'n yawatarisa' ne 'n yausati watarisa.'
z-m-16-01.s.s1.hint.1: Funga kuti chii chinodiwa kutaura nezve 'n dzese,' kwete nhamba yawatarisa kusvika zvino chete.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.0.info: Kana ukaisa n=1, 2, 3, 4, 5, mitengo i 43, 47, 53, 61, 71. Zvishanu zvose i prime numbers.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.0.ask: Unofunga chii zvino nezvechirevo cheshamwari yako?
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.0.after: Kutarisa kwemakumi mashanu i chiratidzo chinotsigira chirevo. Asi n i dzisingagumi, saka kuti utaure 'nguva dzose,' unofanira kuedza dzimwe zvakawanda kana kutsvaga chikonzero.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Zvishanu zvose zvaiva prime, saka tinogona kutaura kuti i prime kuna n ipi neipi
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Kuva nechokwadi kashanu i chiratidzo, kwete kutarisa n dzese. Chii chimwe chinodiwa kutaura nezve 'n dzese'?
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Zvinoratidzika zvine musoro, asi ndinoda kuedza kana zvichishandawo kuna n hombe
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wakagamuchira chiratidzo, uye wakafungawo nezvechokwadi chekuti pane n dzakawanda dzausati watarisa.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Zvaiva zvakarurama kuna n diki chete, uye kuna n hombe composite number inofanira kubuda
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Hapana humbowo hwekuti inokundikana kuna n hombe zvakare. Usati watarisa, haugone kuva nechokwadi nenzira ipi neipi.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Kubva pazviitiko zvishanu bedzi hatigone kuziva chinhu pamutsara uyu
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Chokwadi chekuti nguva shanu dzose dzaiva prime i ruzivo zvakare. Sarudza kuti ungavimba nacho zvakadini.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.1.info: Pirogiramu yekombiyuta yakaverenga mitengo yese 40 kubva ku n=0 kusvika ku n=39, uye mutengo wese waiva prime number.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.1.ask: Unoona sei chirevo cheshamwari yako zvino?
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.1.after: Kunyangwe 40 dzose dzakarurama, uku hakusi humbowo. Zvakakodzera kuti zvinzi fungidziro ine musoro.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Dzose 40 dzaiva prime, saka zvino tinogona kutaura kuti 'nguva dzose prime'
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.1.r.a: 40 inhamba huru, asi kuchiri nemakosha e n makuru kupfuura 40. Kunyange kana nhamba yawakaongorora ichikura, hauna kuongorora 'n dzose.'
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Kubva pa n=40 zvichienda, ndiyo nguva yekuti nhamba dzakabatanidzwa dzibude
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Kuva wakarurama kare hakuiti kuti ndiyo 'nguva' yekuva wakaipa inotevera. Pane chikonzero chaunoona nacho izvi here?
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Kufungidzira kwakanaka, asi hatisati taziva kana kuchiri kushanda kune n dzose
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Rakachengeta pfungwa yekuti kana kuongorora kuchiunganidzwa, kuvimba kunokura, asi 'zvose' zvinoda chikonzero kana kuongorora zvose.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Takaongorora 40, saka hatidi kuongorora n=41 nezvichatevera
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Chikamu chawakaongorora hachisi chose. Pachine chikamu chasara chisina kuongororwa.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.2.info: Kana ukaisa n=40, unowana 40×40+40+41=1681. Asi 41×41 inewo 1681.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.2.ask: Mugumisiro uyu unokuudza chii nezvechirevo cheshamwari yako?
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.2.after: 1681=41×41 haisi nhamba prime. Muenzaniso mumwe unoratidza kuti 'nguva dzose prime' hachishandi.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Dzekutanga 40 dzose dzaiva prime, saka kuverenga kwe n=40 kunofanira kuva kwakaipa
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Kana ukahadzika kuverenga, unogona kuverenga zvakare. Haufanire kukanda mugumisiro mutsva nokuda kwekuti mugumisiro wekare mizhinji.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Kubva zvino, tinofanira kutaura kuti nhamba dzakabatanidzwa dzinobuda kune n dzose
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wakawedzera zvakanyanya kurutivi rwakapesana. Kuwana nyaya imwe chete hakuiti kuti nyaya dzose dzive dzakapesana.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Ndi n=40 chete yakasiyana, saka tinogona kutaura kuti i prime kune n dzakawanda
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.2.r.c: 'Dzakawanda' hadzisati dzaongororwa futi. Unofanira kuwana kuti nhamba dzakabatanidzwa dzinobudawo here pa n=41 nezvichatevera.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Nhamba yakabatanidzwa yakabuda pa n=40, saka 'nguva dzose prime' ibhuku
z-m-16-01.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Wakaziva kuti muenzaniso mumwe unoputsa 'nguva dzose,' ndokugamuchira mugumisiro mutsva sezvawakanga wakaita.
z-m-16-01.s.s1.reflect: Kuvimba kwako kwakachinja sei kana mhinduro dzakauya dzekusvika pa n=5, kusvika pa39, uye zvino n=40? Chii chakasiyana pakati pemienzaniso yakarurama inounganidzwa nemuenzaniso mumwe usina kururama unoonekwa?
z-m-16-01.s.s2.prompt: Wana makosha 2 akasiyana e n, n iri integer kubva pa0 kusvika pa100, umo kukosha kwe n×n+n+41 kusiri prime (kwakabatanidzwa), uye uaise.
z-m-16-01.s.s2.hint.0: Kusvika pa n=39 dzose dzaiva prime. Verenga makosha nenzira kubva pa n inotevera zvichienda.
z-m-16-01.s.s2.hint.1: Kana kukosha kuri kukuru, ongorora kana kugovanisika ne2, 3, 5, 7, ... nenzira iyi.
z-m-16-01.s.s2.ok.c1: n i integer kubva pa0 kusvika pa100.
z-m-16-01.s.s2.fail.c1: n haisi integer kubva pa0 kusvika pa100.
z-m-16-01.s.s2.fail.c2: Kune n iyi kukosha i prime. Tsvaga imwe n.
z-m-16-01.s.s2.explain: Kune n=40 i1681=41×41, kune n=41 i41×41+41+41=1763=41×43, uye kune n=44 i2021=43×47, saka nhamba dzakabatanidzwa dzinobuda. Kunyange nyaya 40 dzakarurama, muenzaniso unopokana wakabva wauya.
z-m-16-01.s.s3.prompt: Unoda kuudza shamwari yeklabhu yako izvi: "Kunyange kana yaiva prime kune n dzose kubva pa0 kusvika pa39, haufanire kutaura 'nguva dzose prime.'" Nyora chikonzero, uchishandisa kukosha kumwe chete kwe n kwawakawana pamusoro.
z-m-16-01.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wanyora imwe n yawakawana pamusoro nemugumisiro wekuverenga kwayo.
z-m-16-01.s.s3.hint.1: Taura kuti izwi ripi ('nguva dzose') muchirevo cheshamwari yako mugumisiro uyu usingaenderani naro.
z-m-16-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Zvakajeka here kuti kukosha hakusi prime pa n yawakapa?
z-m-16-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Rinosanganisira here pfungwa yekuti 'ndakaongorora zvakawanda' ne'ndakaongorora nyaya dzose' zvakasiyana?
z-m-16-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakataura here kuti kunyange muenzaniso mumwe unoputsa 'nguva dzose'?
z-m-16-01.s.s3.model.0: Kune n=40, 1681=41×41, saka haisi prime. Kunyange makosha 40 akava prime, kana n imwe chete yakadaro ikabuda, 'nguva dzose prime' inova ibhuku.
z-m-16-01.s.s3.model.1: Zvisinei nokuti unoongorora zvakawanda sei, hauna kuongorora n dzose. Chaizvoizvo pa n=41 unowana 41×43=1763, nhamba yakabatanidzwa, saka haufanire kutaura 'nguva dzose.'
z-m-16-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Rine pfungwa mbiri dzose: muenzaniso mumwe unopokana, uye 'zvose, kwete huwandu.'

z-m-16-02.thinking.1: Kugadzira nyaya dzakati wandei dzinosangana nemamiriro
z-m-16-02.title: Kana mabhazi maviri achibva pamwe chete kwekutanga
z-m-16-02.goal: Siyanisa kukosha kunoshanda pamwe chete nekukosha kunoshanda 'kwekutanga,' gadzira iwe amene mapeya enguva dzakapfuura anokodzera mamiriro, uye utsanangure kuti nei nyaya dzisingagoneki dzisingagoneki.
z-m-16-02.material: Pachiteshi chebhazi chimwe, bhazi rerudzi 가 rinobva pamaminitsi 12 ega ega uye bhazi rerudzi 나 rinobva pamaminitsi 18 ega ega. Nhasi pa9 a.m. chaizvo mabhazi maviri akabva pamwe chete, uye shure kwaizvozvo rudzi rwega rwega runochengeta nguva yaro chaizvo ndokuenderera mberi nekubva. Harin akati, "Shure kwemaminitsi 12×18=216, nekuwanza nguva mbiri idzi, ndiko kuti pa12:36 p.m., achabva pamwe chete zvakare kwekutanga!"
z-m-16-02.thinking.0: Kusiyanisa 'pamwe chete' ne'kwekutanga' mumhinduro yomumwe munhu
z-m-16-02.thinking.2: Kutsanangura kuti nei chimwe chinhu chisingagoneki
z-m-16-02.prereq.0: Revo yezvinowanzwa, nekunyora zvinowanzwa zvenhamba nenzira
z-m-16-02.prereq.1: Kuverenga nenguva muawa nemaminitsi (kushandura maminitsi kuita nguva yezuva)
z-m-16-02.s.s1.prompt: Wakatarisa zvakataurwa naHarin. Sarudza kuongorora kwakakodzera zvikuru.
z-m-16-02.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora nguva (nemaminitsi) apo rudzi 가 rinobva, sa12, 24, ..., uye unyore rudzi 나 zvakaparadzana.
z-m-16-02.s.s1.hint.1: Wana nguva dzose dziri mumitsara yose miviri uye uongorore kuti ndeipi yekutanga.
z-m-16-02.s.s1.o.a: Shure kwemaminitsi 12+18=30, huwandu hwenguva mbiri, ndiyo nguva yavanobva pamwe chete zvakare kwekutanga
z-m-16-02.s.s1.r.a: Ongorora kana rudzi 가 rwunobva shure kwemaminitsi 30. Rudzi 가 runobva pamaminitsi 12 ega ega.
z-m-16-02.s.s1.o.b: Vanobva pamwe chete kwekutanga shure kwemaminitsi 18, nguva refu
z-m-16-02.s.s1.r.b: Rudzi 나 runobva shure kwemaminitsi 18. Ongorora kana rudzi 가 runobva pamaminitsi 18.
z-m-16-02.s.s1.o.c: Shure kwemaminitsi 216 yakarurama. Nguva inowanikwa nekuwanza nguva mbiri ndiyo nguva yavanobva pamwe chete kwekutanga.
z-m-16-02.s.s1.r.c: Ichokwadi kuti marudzi ose maviri anobva pahuwandu hwakawanzwa. Asi wakaongorora here kuti hapana nguva yakare yavanobva pamwe chete?
z-m-16-02.s.s1.o.d: Vanobvawo pamwe chete shure kwemaminitsi 216, asi pane nguva yakare, saka haisi "yekutanga"
z-m-16-02.s.s1.r.d: Wakasiyanisa 'nguva marudzi ose maviri anobva' ne'nguva yekutanga marudzi ose maviri anobva.'
z-m-16-02.s.s1.explain: Zvinowanzwa ze12 i12, 24, 36, ... uye zvinowanzwa ze18 i18, 36, 54, ..., saka vanobva pamwe chete kwekutanga shure kwemaminitsi 36 (pa9:36). Maminitsi 216 i6 nguva 36, saka vanobvawo pamwe chete ipapo, asi haisi nguva 'yekutanga.'
z-m-16-02.s.s2.prompt: Heino hurongwa hwemarudzi matsva. Marudzi maviri anobva pamwe chete pa9 a.m., uye nguva inotevera yavanobva pamwe chete kwekutanga inofanira kuva 9:36 (maminitsi 36 shure). Sarudza nguva yerudzi 가 a maminitsi uye nguva yerudzi 나 b maminitsi. a ne b dzinhamba dzechisikigo kubva pa2 kusvika pa36, uye a inofanira kuva diki kupfuura b. Wana 3 (a, b) dzakasiyana.
z-m-16-02.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza peya imwe sa a=6, b=9, nyora nguva dzinobva rudzi rwega rwega, uye uwane nguva yekutanga yavanosangana.
z-m-16-02.s.s2.hint.1: Enzanisa zvaunofanira kuchinja kana nguva yekutanga yekusangana iri pakare kupfuura maminitsi 36 nezvaunofanira kuchinja kana iri shure kupfuura maminitsi 36.
z-m-16-02.s.s2.fail.c1: a ne b dzinofanira kuva nhamba dzechisikigo kubva pa2 kusvika pa36 ne a<b.
z-m-16-02.s.s2.ok.c2: Nguva yekutanga yavanobva pamwe chete ndiyo maminitsi 36 shure chaizvo.
z-m-16-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Nguva yekutanga yavanobva pamwe chete haisi maminitsi 36 shure. Nyora zvinowanzwa zvenguva mbiri nenzira uye uongorore.
z-m-16-02.s.s2.explain: Semuenzaniso, ye (4, 9), zvinowanzwa ze4 (4, 8, ..., 36) nezvinowanzwa ze9 (9, 18, 27, 36) zvinosangana kwekutanga pa36. (12, 18) ndiyo mamiriro epakutanga. Mapeya anosangana panguva yakare kupfuura 36 ((6, 9) inosangana pamaminitsi 18) kana mapeya anoshaya 36 ((5, 7) inosangana pamaminitsi 35) hadzikodzere mamiriro.
z-m-16-02.s.s3.prompt: Kana nguva yerudzi 나 iri maminitsi 8, unogona kuvaita kuti vabve pamwe chete kwekutanga pa9:36 zvisinei nokuti unosarudza sei nguva yerudzi 가 here? Nyora kutonga kwako nechikonzero.
z-m-16-02.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora nguva dzinobva rudzi 나 (nguva yemaminitsi 8), sa8, 16, ....
z-m-16-02.s.s3.hint.1: Ongorora kana 36 iri pakati penguva idzi.
z-m-16-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Chikonzero chako chinotsanangurwa nerudzi 나 (nguva yemaminitsi 8) oga here, kana inyaya yekuedza nguva dzakawanda dzerudzi 가?
z-m-16-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakataura here kana rudzi 나 rwunobva pamaminitsi 36?
z-m-16-02.s.s3.model.0: Hazvigoneki. Rudzi 나 runobva pamaminitsi 0, 8, 16, 24, 32, 40, saka harubvi pamaminitsi 36. Izvi zvinoitika nokuti 36 haisi kuwanza kwe8.
z-m-16-02.s.s3.model.1: Hazvigoneki. 36÷8 i4.5, saka hazvigovanisiki zvakakwana. Kana rudzi 나 rusingabvi pamaminitsi 36, zvisinei nezvaunoita nerudzi 가, havagoni kubva pamwe chete pamaminitsi 36.

z-m-16-03.title: Kuwana huwandu hwema integer anotevedzana ane huwandu hwe10
z-m-16-03.goal: Shandisa chimiro chekuti nhamba dzakapesana dzinowedzera kuita 0 muhuwandu hwema integer anotevedzana akasanganiswa anogadzirwa nenhamba dzakanaka nedzakaipa, kuwana huwandu hwakawanda hwunokodzera mamiriro uye utsanangure kuti nei.
z-m-16-03.material: Ngatitii 'S(s, e)' ikukosha kunowanikwa nekuwedzera ma integer ose rimwe nerimwe kubva pa integer s kusvika pa e (s i integer isingapfuuri e). Semuenzaniso, kana s=−2 ne e=3, i(−2)+(−1)+0+1+2+3=3. 0 i integer futi, uye s ne e dzinowedzerwawo.
z-m-16-03.prereq.1: Huwandu hwenhamba mbiri dzine absolute value imwe chete asi zviratidzo zvakapesana
z-m-16-03.s.s1.prompt: S(−3, 5) i chii, ndiko kuti kukosha kwekuwedzera ma integer ose kubva pa−3 kusvika pa5? Sarudza uchifunga kana pane nzira yekuiwana usingawedzeri rimwe nerimwe.
z-m-16-03.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora nhamba dzose kubva pa−3 kusvika pa5 uye ubatanidze nemitsara nhamba dzine absolute value imwe chete.
z-m-16-03.s.s1.hint.1: Wedzera pamwe chete nhamba dzisina kubatanidzwa chete.
z-m-16-03.s.s1.r.a: Unogona kutsanangura here kuti wakashandisa sei nhamba dzinoita mapeya? Kana wakazvigadzirisa saizvozvo, wakaona chimiro zvakanaka.
z-m-16-03.s.s1.r.b: Uku kukosha kwekuwedzera nhamba mbiri dziri kumagumo chete, −3 ne5. Unofanira kuwedzerawo nhamba dziri pakati.
z-m-16-03.s.s1.r.c: Uku kukosha kwekuwedzera nhamba dzakanaka chete kubva pa1 kusvika pa5. Nhamba dzakaipa ne0 dzinowedzerwawo.
z-m-16-03.s.s1.r.d: Kubva pa−3 kusvika pa3 dzinobvisana, asi 4 ne5 dzinosara.
z-m-16-03.s.s1.explain: −3 ne3, −2 ne2, −1 ne1 zvinowedzera kuita 0, uye kuwedzera 0 hakuchinji chinhu. Kuwedzera 4 ne5 dzakasara kunopa 9.
z-m-16-03.s.s2.prompt: Wana uye uise 3 (s, e) dzakasiyana, s ne e dziri ma integer kubva pa−20 kusvika pa20 (s isingapfuuri e), umo S(s, e) iri chaizvo 10.
z-m-16-03.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza nhamba yekutanga uye uwedzere nhamba yekupedzisira ne1 panguva, uchinyora huwandu nenzira.
z-m-16-03.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa kuti nhamba dzipi dzinobvisana kana ukatanga kusanganisira nhamba dzakaipa.
z-m-16-03.s.s2.ok.c1: s ne e ma integer kubva pa−20 kusvika pa20, uye s haipfuuri e.
z-m-16-03.s.s2.fail.c1: s ne e ma integer kubva pa−20 kusvika pa20, uye s haigoni kupfuura e.
z-m-16-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Huwandu kubva pa s kusvika pa e i10.
z-m-16-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Kukosha kwekuwedzera zvose kubva pa s kusvika pa e hakusi 10. Ongorora zvakare kuti uri kuwedzera nhamba dzingani.
z-m-16-03.s.s2.explain: Mumuganhu uyu, huwandu hune huwandu hwe10 ndihwo mana: (1, 4), (0, 4), (10, 10), (−9, 10). (−9, 10) inyaya umo −9 kusvika pa9 dzinobvisana uye 10 chete inosara.
z-m-16-03.s.s3.prompt: Tsanangura kuti nei S(−9, 10)=10 usingawedzeri nhamba dzose 20.
z-m-16-03.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora nhamba dzose kubva pa−9 kusvika pa10 uye uite mapeya enhamba dzine absolute value imwe chete.
z-m-16-03.s.s3.hint.1: Tsvaga nhamba ipi neipi isina kugona kuitwa peya.
z-m-16-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakanyora zvakananga here kuti nhamba dzipi dzinoita peya nedzipi?
z-m-16-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakanyora here kuti nhamba ipi yasara isina mumwe wayo uye nei yasara?
z-m-16-03.s.s3.model.0: Nhamba dzine absolute value imwe chete asi zviratidzo zvakapesana, sa−9 ne9, −8 ne8, dzinowedzera kuita 0. Kuwedzera 0 hakuchinji chinhu, uye 10 chete, isina mumwe wayo, inosara, saka huwandu i10.
z-m-16-03.s.s3.model.1: Nhamba dzakaipa −9 kusvika pa−1 dzinoita mapeya rimwe nerimwe nenhamba dzakanaka 1 kusvika pa9 uye dzose dzinowedzera kuita 0. Zvinosara ndi0 ne10, saka huwandu i10.

z-m-16-04.title: Kusarudza coefficient kuti mhinduro ive nhamba yechisikigo
z-m-16-04.topic: Mhinduro dzema equation akananga nema coefficient
z-m-16-04.goal: Edza kuti mhinduro inochinja sei kana coefficient ye equation ichichinja, gadzira ma coefficient akawanda anopa mhinduro yenhamba yechisikigo, uye utsanangure kuti nei dzimwe nyaya dzisingashande.
z-m-16-04.material: Pane equation ax+6=2x+12 (a nguva x kuwedzera 6 inoenzana ne2x kuwedzera 12). a i integer, uye mhinduro x inochinja ne a. Tinoda kuwana a umo mhinduro iri 'nhamba yechisikigo' (1, 2, 3, ...).
z-m-16-04.thinking.0: Kucherekedza kuti mhinduro inochinja sei kana coefficient ichichinja
z-m-16-04.thinking.2: Kusiyanisa nyaya isina mhinduro nenyaya umo mhinduro isiri nhamba yechisikigo
z-m-16-04.prereq.0: Kugadzirisa ma equation akananga (kutamisa mazwi, kugovanisa mativi ose maviri nenhamba imwe chete)
z-m-16-04.prereq.1: Revo yenhamba dzechisikigo, ma integer, nezvigovanisi
z-m-16-04.s.s1.prompt: Kana a=2, mhinduro ye equation 2x+6=2x+12 i chii?
z-m-16-04.s.s1.hint.0: Bvisa izwi rimwe chete kumativi ose maviri uye upfupise.
z-m-16-04.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa kana equation yakapfupiswa ichokwadi kana ibhuku zvisinei ne x.
z-m-16-04.s.s1.r.a: Kana ukaisa x=0 mumativi ose maviri, unowana 6=12. Ongorora kana inoshanda.
z-m-16-04.s.s1.r.b: Isa 6 pa x uye uverenge mativi ose maviri. Makosha maviri akaenzana here?
z-m-16-04.s.s1.r.c: Wakawana kuti hapana x inoita kuti mativi ose maviri aenzane. Taura kuti mugumisiro uyu unobuda sei.
z-m-16-04.s.s1.r.d: Kana ukabvisa 2x kumativi ose maviri, 6 ne12 dzinosara. Makosha maviri akaenzana here?
z-m-16-04.s.s1.explain: Kana ukabvisa 2x kumativi ose maviri, unowana 6=12, iri ibhuku zvisinei ne x. Saka hapana x inogona kuva mhinduro.
z-m-16-04.s.s2.prompt: Kana a ne x dziri ma integer uye x iri nhamba yechisikigo, wana mapeya 3 (a, x) ane a dzakasiyana umo ax+6=2x+12 inoshanda. (a kubva pa−20 kusvika pa20)
z-m-16-04.s.s2.hint.0: Isa ma integer madiki pa a rimwe panguva, gadzirisa equation, uye uongorore kana mhinduro iri nhamba yechisikigo.
z-m-16-04.s.s2.hint.1: Rongedza mutebhura kuti kune a dzipi mhinduro iri yakaipa uye kune a dzipi iri chidimbu.
z-m-16-04.s.s2.ok.c1: a i integer kubva pa−20 kusvika pa20.
z-m-16-04.s.s2.fail.c1: a inofanira kuva integer kubva pa−20 kusvika pa20.
z-m-16-04.s.s2.fail.c3: Kana ukaisa x ne a mu equation, mativi maviri haaenzani. Verenga uye uongorore.
z-m-16-04.s.s2.explain: Kana a i3, 4, 5, 8, x i6, 3, 2, 1. Kana a=0, x=−3 (haisi nhamba yechisikigo), uye kana a=6, x=1.5 (haisi integer), saka hazvishande.
z-m-16-04.s.s3.prompt: Kana a=7, mhinduro haisi nhamba yechisikigo. Nyora kuti nei isingashande kana a=7, uye utonge unyore kana mhinduro yenhamba yechisikigo ichabuda kunyange kana a i1000.
z-m-16-04.s.s3.hint.0: Mu ax+6=2x+12, unganidza mazwi ane x kudivi rimwe.
z-m-16-04.s.s3.hint.1: Isa coefficient ye x ne6 padivi nedivi mumapeya (a, x) awakawana mu s2, uye uwane chinhu chavakafanana.
z-m-16-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakataura here kuti a−2 inofanira kuva nehukama hupi ne 6 kuti mhinduro ive nhamba yechisikigo?
z-m-16-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Kutonga kwako kwa a=1000 kunobatana nechikonzero chako cha a=7 here?
z-m-16-04.s.s3.model.0: (a−2)x=6, saka x=6÷(a−2). Kana a=7, ndi 6÷5, iyo isiri nhamba yechisikigo. Inhamba yechisikigo kana a−2 iri muparadzanisi we 6 chete, uye kana a=1000, a−2=998, saka hazvishande.
z-m-16-04.s.s3.model.1: (a−2) nguva x inofanira kuva 6. Hapana nhamba yechisikigo inopa 6 kana ukaiwanza na 5, saka a=7 haishande. Kana a=1000, a−2 i 998, uye kuiwanza nenhamba yechisikigo yose kunoita kuti ipfuure 6, saka hazvishande.

z-m-16-07.s.s1.prompt: Ruzivo runoratidzwa chimwe chete panguva. Nguva imwe neimwe, sarudza chiri padyo nezvaunofunga izvozvi.
z-m-16-07.title: Kuenda nokudzoka kwezvikurumidziro zvakasiyana: kumhanya kweavhareji kuri sei?
z-m-16-07.topic: Kumhanya, nguva, chinhambwe, nezvirevo zvine tsamba
z-m-16-07.goal: Ongorora nemienzaniso nechirevo chine tsamba kana mhedzisiro yakagadzikana kunyange chinhambwe chisina kupiwa, uye unzwisise huwandu hupi hwaunoparadzanisa nahwo kana uchitsvaga avhareji.
z-m-16-07.material: Jiho anofamba netsoka kubva kumba kuenda kuraibhurari ne 4km paawa (4km muawa 1) uye anodzoka nenzira imwe chete ne 6km paawa. Haazorori parutivi rwupi zvarwo, uye kumhanya kwake kwakagadzikana. 'Kumhanya kweavhareji kwokuenda nokudzoka' kunotsanangurwa se (chinhambwe chose chokuenda nokudzoka)÷(nguva yose yakatorwa nokuenda nokudzoka). Chinhambwe chiri pakati pekumba neraibhurari hachina kupiwa.
z-m-16-07.thinking.0: Kutonga ruzivo rwunodikanwa mudambudziko rinoratidzika kushaya ruzivo
z-m-16-07.thinking.1: Kupamhidzira kubva pamienzaniso kusvika pachirevo chine tsamba
z-m-16-07.s.s1.hint.0: Sarudza chinhambwe uye uverenge nguva yakatorwa pakuenda nenguva yakatorwa pakudzoka.
z-m-16-07.s.s1.hint.1: Chinja chinhambwe, verenga kamwe zvakare, uye uenzanise mhedzisiro.
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.0.info: Hatisati tazivi chinhambwe. Anofamba ne 4km paawa achienda uye 6km paawa achidzoka.
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.0.ask: Zvino unofungei pamusoro pokumhanya kweavhareji kwokuenda nokudzoka?
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.0.after: Hatisati tazivi chinhambwe, saka zvakare kuti tipe kukosha chaizvo. Zvose zvakafungidzirwa zvokuti iri pakati pe 4 ne 6 nepfungwa yokuti chinhambwe chinoratidzika kudikanwa zvinogona kuedzwa.
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Ichava 5km paawa, pakati chaipo pe 4 ne 6
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Pane chikonzero here chokuti unoiona sepakati chaipo? Izvozvo zvinoreva kuti wakatora nguva yokufamba ne 4km/h nenguva yokufamba ne 6km/h sedzakafanana.
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Zvinoratidzika kuti ikukosha kuri pakati pe 4 ne 6, asi tinofanira kuziva zvimwe kuti tiwane kukosha chaizvo
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Pfungwa yokuti iri pakati pokumhanya kwezvikamu zviviri inonzwisisika. Wakafungawo nezvezvinodikanwa kuti uwane kukosha chaizvo.
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Hatizivi chinhambwe, saka zvinoratidzika kuti hatigoni kuwana kumhanya kweavhareji zvakare
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Zvakajairika kuti chinhambwe chiratidzike chichidikanwa. Kana ukafungidzira chinhambwe woverenga, unogona kutarisa kana chichidikanwa zvechokwadi.
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Ikukosha kwokuenda nokudzoka kwose kwakaparadzaniswa nenguva yakatorwa. Funga kana ichigona kukurumidza kupfuura kumhanya kukurumidza zvikuru.
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.1.info: Ngatifungidzirei chinhambwe chi 12km. Kuenda kunotora 12÷4=3 maawa uye kudzoka kunotora 12÷6=2 maawa. Saka akaita kuenda nokudzoka kwe 24km mumaawa 5.
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.1.ask: Kumhanya kweavhareji kwokuenda nokudzoka kunova km mangani paawa, ipapo?
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.1.after: 24÷5=4.8. Kumhanya kweavhareji hakusi avhareji yokumhanya kuviri asi chinhambwe chose chakaparadzaniswa nenguva yose.
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.1.r.a: 5 iri pakati chaipo pe 4 ne 6. Paradzanisa iwe pachako kuti uone kuti ndi km mangani paawa kana akafamba 24km mumaawa 5.
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Tarisa kuti wakawana sei mutengo uyu. Verenga 24÷5.
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Verenga 24÷5 zvakare. Tarisa kana ichienderana nemutengo uyu.
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Wakapatsanura hurefu hwese hwekuenda nekudzoka nenguva yese. Hauna kungoita avhareji yekumhanya kwezvikamu.
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.2.info: Kana hurefu i 24km, kuenda kunotora 24÷4=6 maawa uye kudzoka kunotora 24÷6=4 maawa, saka kunotora maawa 10, uye kuenda nekudzoka i 48km. Avhareji yekumhanya i 48÷10=4.8, iyo i 4.8km paawa imwe.
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ngatidzokere kutanga. Kana usingazivi hurefu, ungati chii nezve avhareji yekumhanya kwekuenda nekudzoka?
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.2.after: Yaiva 4.8km/h kaviri kose, saka ingangodaro ichiva imwechete chero hurefu. Usati watarisa nekuti hurefu i ravara d, zvakare kutaura kuti i imwechete pahurefu hwese.
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Inogona kuwanikwa chete kana tichiziva hurefu
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Yaiva 4.8 pa 12km nepa 24km. Ungatsanangura sei kuti mhedzisiro yaiva imwechete kunyangwe hurefu hwaisiyana?
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Yaiva 4.8 muzviitiko zvose zviviri, saka zvinoita sekuti i 4.8 chero hurefu
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wakatora mutengo mumwechete unobuda mumienzaniso miviri sechiratidzo. Unofanira kutarisa neravara kuti zvinoshanda pahurefu hwese.
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Kana hurefu huchikura, avhareji yekumhanya inowedzera
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Avhareji yekumhanya yaiva imwechete pa 12km nepa 24km. Haina kukura.
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Ndatarisa zviitiko zviviri chete, saka ndinoda kuti hurefu hunzi d km uye ndiongorore kana i imwechete pahurefu hwese
z-m-16-07.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Iyi i maitiro ekutarisa neravara usati wapa mhedziso hombe kubva pamienzaniso miviri.
z-m-16-07.s.s1.reflect: Kufunga kwako kwakachinja sei pafungidziro yekutanga, apo wakafungidzira kuti hurefu i 12km, uye apo wakafungidzira 24km? Yaiva 'dambudziko apo usingazivi hurefu,' asi hurefu hwaidiwa chaizvo here?
z-m-16-07.s.s2.prompt: Iyi i nzira yaJiho yekugadzirisa, yakaverengwa nekuti hurefu i d km. Sarudza mutsetse mumwe usingavimbike. (Unogona kusarudza mutsetse une kuverenga kwakaipa, kana mutsetse apo mhedziso isina kururama yakanyorwa nekuda kwazvo.)
z-m-16-07.s.s2.hint.0: Enzanisa mhedzisiro yenzira iyi nemhedzisiro yakaverengwa pakutanga ne 12km.
z-m-16-07.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa mutsetse nemutsetse kana mutsetse wega wega unotevera kubva pamutsetse wawuri pamberi pawo, uchiverenga zvakare mutsetse wega wega.
z-m-16-07.s.s2.line.0: Regai hurefu kubva kumusha kuenda kurabhurari ive d km.
z-m-16-07.s.s2.line.1: Nguva yekuenda i d÷4=d/4 (maawa), uye nguva yekudzoka i d÷6=d/6 (maawa).
z-m-16-07.s.s2.line.2: Nguva yese yekuenda nekudzoka i d/4+d/6=2d/10=d/5 (maawa).
z-m-16-07.s.s2.line.3: Hurefu hwekuenda nekudzoka i 2d km, saka avhareji yekumhanya i 2d÷(d/5)=10 (km/h).
z-m-16-07.s.s2.line.4: Saka, chero hurefu hwuri hupi, avhareji yekumhanya i 10km paawa imwe.
z-m-16-07.s.s2.explain: Kukanganisa kuri mumutsetse 3. d/4+d/6 inofanira kuitwa kuti ive nedenominator imwechete: 3d/12+2d/12=5d/12 (maawa). Haufanire kuwedzera ma numerators pamwe chete nema denominators pamwe chete. Ipapo avhareji yekumhanya i 2d÷(5d/12)=24/5=4.8 (km/h), uye d inobviswa, saka i imwechete chero hurefu. 10km/h mumitsetse 4 ne 5 i mhedzisiro inotakura kukanganisa kwemutsetse 3, uye inosiyana ne 4.8 yakawanikwa pakutanga, saka unogona kuiramba. Nzira 'haienderani nehurefu' i yakarurama.
z-m-16-07.s.s3.prompt: Nyora kuti nei avhareji yekumhanya kwekuenda nekudzoka i 4.8, yakaderera kupfuura 5, panzvimbo pe 5, iri pakati pe 4 ne 6, uchicherekedza nguva yekuenda nenguva yekudzoka.
z-m-16-07.s.s3.hint.0: Enzanisa nguva yakatorwa kuenda nenguva yakatorwa kudzoka.
z-m-16-07.s.s3.hint.1: Tarisa kuti anofamba nekumhanya kupi kwenguva refu, uye ufunge kuti avhareji inosvika padyo nerutivi rupi.
z-m-16-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakabatanidza chokwadi chekuti 'nguva i refu' nemhedziso yekuti 'avhareji iri padyo neinononoka' here?
z-m-16-07.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Kana wakapa muenzaniso chaiwo sa 12km, wakanyora zvakarurama mitengo sa maawa 3 ekuenda uye maawa 2 ekudzoka here?
z-m-16-07.s.s3.model.0: Kuenda, kana achifamba zvishoma nezvishoma, kunotora nguva refu. Panguva yese, yakawanda inoshandiswa kufamba pa 4km paawa imwe, saka avhareji i 4.8, ichiramba ne 4 pane 5.
z-m-16-07.s.s3.model.1: Kana hurefu i 12km, kuenda kunotora maawa 3 uye kudzoka kunotora maawa 2. Nguva yekufamba pa 4km paawa imwe i refu, saka kumhanya uku kunokanganisa avhareji zvakawanda, uye inova diki kupfuura 5.

z-m-16-08.title: Tinogona kudaidza hukama uhu function here?
z-m-16-08.goal: Tonga kana chinhu i function nekuti pane mutengo mumwe chaizvo we y unosarudzwa kumutengo wese we x, ratidza nemuenzaniso unopokana hukama husiri function, uye utsanangure kuti nei mitengo yakasiyana ye x inogona kuva ne y imwechete.
z-m-16-08.material: Mutemo unoisa mutengo we y nemutengo wese waunosarudza we x unonzi 'hukama.' Muhukama, kana mutengo mumwe chaizvo we y wasarudzwa kumutengo wese we x, y inonzi function ye x. (Kana, mutengo we x wasarudzwa, mitengo 2 kana kupfuura ye y ikabuda, haisi function.)
z-m-16-08.thinking.1: Kugadzira counterexample kuratidza kuti chinhu hachisi function
z-m-16-08.prereq.0: Zvinoreva natural numbers, divisors, multiples, ne remainders
z-m-16-08.prereq.1: Zvinoreva hukama se 'mutemo unoisa mitengo ye y nemitengo ye x'
z-m-16-08.s.s1.prompt: Kana x i natural number, sarudza hukama hwese hwuri pazasi apo y i function ye x.
z-m-16-08.s.s1.hint.0: Isa natural numbers dzidiki dzvakati wandei kuna x uye unyore patafura kuti y mangani dzinobuda.
z-m-16-08.s.s1.hint.1: Tsvaga kana pane x imwe chete apo y 2 kana kupfuura dzinobuda.
z-m-16-08.s.s1.o.a: Regai y ive divisor ye x
z-m-16-08.s.s1.r.a: Kana x=6, y i mitengo yakati wandei: 1, 2, 3, 6. Verenga kuti y mangani dzinoenderana ne x imwe.
z-m-16-08.s.s1.o.b: Regai y ive remainder kana x ikapatsanurwa ne 6
z-m-16-08.s.s1.r.b: Kana x wasarudzwa, remainder inosarudzwa semutengo mumwe. Kana wakasarudza izvi mushure mekutarisa izvozvo, wakashandisa tsananguro zvakanaka.
z-m-16-08.s.s1.o.c: Regai y ive natural number diki kupfuura x
z-m-16-08.s.s1.r.c: Kana x=4, y i mitengo yakati wandei: 1, 2, 3.
z-m-16-08.s.s1.o.d: Regai y ive nhamba iri 1 kupfuura 2 nguva x
z-m-16-08.s.s1.r.d: Kana x wasarudzwa, y inosarudzwa semutengo mumwe chete 2x+1.
z-m-16-08.s.s1.o.e: Regai y ive multiple ye x
z-m-16-08.s.s1.r.e: Kana x=3, y i mitengo yakati wandei: 3, 6, 9, ....
z-m-16-08.s.s1.explain: Pa b ne d, y inosarudzwa semutengo mumwe kana x wasarudzwa. Pa a, c, e, y dzakawanda dzinobuda ku x imwe, sa pa x=6, 4, 3, saka hadzisi ma functions.
z-m-16-08.s.s2.prompt: Kuna x gore rekuberekwa uye y hurefu hwemunhu mu cm, zvinonzi 'hukama hunosarudza mudzidzi mumwe uye hunoisa hurefu y yemudzidzi iyoyo nemakore x emudzidzi iyoyo' hahusi function. Gadzira mienzaniso 2 yakasiyana ichiratidza chikonzero. Isa (makore, hurefu) evadzidzi vaviri vemakore akafanana. (Makore i integer kubva ku 8 kusvika ku 19 uye hurefu i integer kubva ku 120 kusvika ku 200, uye hurefu hwemudzidzi wekutanga y1 hunofanira kuva shoma kupfuura hwemudzidzi wechipiri y2.)
z-m-16-08.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga wafunga nezvevadzidzi vaviri vemakore akafanana, uye uite kuti hurefu hwavo hwuve hwakasiyana.
z-m-16-08.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa kuti mamiriro ese maviri, makore akafanana nehurefu hwakasiyana, akachengetwa.
z-m-16-08.s.s2.fail.c1: Makore anofanira kuva integer kubva ku 8 kusvika ku 19 uye hurefu integer kubva ku 120 kusvika ku 200.
z-m-16-08.s.s2.fail.c2: Vadzidzi vaviri vanofanira kuva nemakore akafanana.
z-m-16-08.s.s2.fail.c3: Hurefu hwemudzidzi wekutanga hunofanira kuva shoma kupfuura hwemudzidzi wechipiri (hunofanira kusiyana).
z-m-16-08.s.s2.explain: Kana pane vadzidzi vakawanda vane makore 13 vane hurefu 155cm ne 162cm, saka y haina kusarudzwa semutengo mumwe pa x=13. Saka hukama uhu hahusi function. Vadzidzi vemakore akasiyana havagone kuva counterexample.
z-m-16-08.s.s3.prompt: Kana x i natural number, kana 'y i remainder kana x ikapatsanurwa ne 6,' saka y=1 kana x=7 uye y=1 pa x=13 zvakare. Mitengo yakasiyana ye x ine y imwechete inopokana nemamiriro e function here? Nyora kutonga kwako nechikonzero.
z-m-16-08.s.s3.hint.0: Verenga kuti y mangani kana x=7 uye y mangani kana x=13.
z-m-16-08.s.s3.hint.1: Verenga zvakare mutsetse unotsanangura function mubasa iri uye uise mamaki pane izwi rekuti "mumwe" rinoreva.
z-m-16-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakataura kana pane y imwe chete kana x=7, uye kana pane y imwe chete kana x=13 here?
z-m-16-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakasiyanisa 'y imwechete inoonekwa kaviri' ne 'y 2 ku x imwe' here?
z-m-16-08.s.s3.model.0: Hazvipokani. Function inoda chete kuti y imwe chaizvo isarudzwe kune x yega yega. Kana x=7, y i 1 chete, uye kana x=13, i 1 chete zvakare, saka zvakanaka.
z-m-16-08.s.s3.model.1: Hapana dambudziko. Mutemo unotarisa chete kana y imwe chaizvo ichibuda kana x wasarudzwa, saka mitengo yakasiyana ye x inogona kushandisa y imwechete. Kune rimwe divi, kana y 2 dzichibuda ku x imwe, haisi function.

z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.1.ask: Unofunga chii zvino nezvechirevo cheshamwari yako?
z-m-16-09.title: Graph ye direct proportion ine a hombe inogara iri pamusoro here?
z-m-16-09.topic: Kuenzanisa mitengo ye direct proportion y=ax
z-m-16-09.goal: Tarisa nemienzaniso kuti mhedzisiro yekuenzanisa mitengo yema direct proportions maviri y=ax ne y=bx inochinja nechiratidzo che x, gadzirisa chirevo nekuwedzera mamiriro, uye ugadzire counterexample iwe pachako.
z-m-16-09.material: Pa coordinate plane imwe, wakadhonza graph ye y=3x (3 nguva x) uye graph ye y=2x. Shamwari yakati, "Kuna x imwechete, mutengo we y=3x unogara uri mukuru kupfuura mutengo we y=2x. Saka graph ye y=3x inogara iri yakakwirira!" (Hapana mufananidzo. Graph 'iri pamusoro' zvinoreva kuti kuna x imwechete, mutengo we y i mukuru. Unogona kuisa nhamba kuna x uye kuenzanisa mitengo miviri ye y.)
z-m-16-09.thinking.0: Kuedza chirevo chakawanikwa kubva pamienzaniso mishoma
z-m-16-09.thinking.1: Kutsvaga mamiriro (chiratidzo che x) uye kugadzirisa chirevo
z-m-16-09.prereq.0: Kuisa nhamba kuna x mu direct proportion y=ax kuwana y (kusanganisira nhamba dzine negative)
z-m-16-09.prereq.1: Kuwanza nhamba dzine negative nekuenzanisa hukuru hwenhamba
z-m-16-09.s.s1.prompt: Data inoratidzwa chidimbu chimwe panguva. Nguva imwe neimwe, sarudza chakanyanya kuswedera pane zvaunofunga zvino.
z-m-16-09.s.s1.hint.0: Pachinhanho chimwe nechimwe, siyanisa mhando dze x dzawatarisa (positive, 0, negative).
z-m-16-09.s.s1.hint.1: Kuna x imwechete, nyora mitengo yemitsara miviri padivi pedivi uye uenzanise kuti ipi i hombe.
z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.0.info: Kana x=1, y=3x i 3 uye y=2x i 2. Kana x=2, i 6 ne 4, uye kana x=5, i 15 ne 10.
z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.0.ask: Unofunga chii zvino nezvechirevo cheshamwari yako, 'Kuna x imwechete, mutengo we y=3x unogara uri mukuru'?
z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.0.after: Ma x awatarisa ese i positive. Kuti utaure 'nguva dzose,' unofanira kutarisawo ma x asiri positive.
z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Yaiva yakarurama muzviitiko zvitatu zvose, saka i yakarurama kuna x dzese
z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ma x awatarisa i 1, 2, ne 5 chete. Wakatarisawo ma x ari 0, negative, kana ma decimals here?
z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Tinofanira kuedzawo ma x ari 0 kana negative
z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wakaona kuti ma x ese awatarisa i positive uye wakati uchaedza mamwe mhando dze x.
z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.0.o.c: 3 i hombe kupfuura 2, saka inogara yakarurama pasina kutarisa
z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Chokwadi kuti coefficient i hombe, asi kuti mhedzisiro yekuwanza ne x i hombe nguva dzose zvinoenderana nemutengo we x.
z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Zvakadaro chete kana x i hombe, uye kana x i diki inofanira kuva isina kururama
z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Hapana humbowo hwekuti isina kururama kuna x diki. Unogona kuziva nekuverenga zvakananga.
z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.1.info: Kana x=0, mitengo miviri i 0 ne 0, yakafanana. Kana x=−1, y=3x i −3 uye y=2x i −2. Kana x=−4, i −12 ne −8.
z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.1.after: Kana x i positive, 3x i hombe kupfuura 2x; pa x=0 dzakaenzana; uye kana x i negative, 3x i diki kupfuura 2x. 'Nguva dzose' i manyepo, uye unofanira kuwedzera mamiriro 'kana x i positive.'
z-m-16-09.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Nhamba dzine negative i mamiriro akasarudzika, saka chirevo chakarurama sezvakaita
